tweet.text:
Since the start of October, agents have written nearly every pull request we’ve merged into Runway App Studio.

Our latest engineering post explains how we built a system that reviews those changes, tests them in a browser and brings in an engineer for high-risk decisions.
https://runway.com/news/engineering/building-a-software-factory
